note: Sound for the start-light countdown: the F1 start-light tone on each lamp, then a real launch recording at lights out. Cue positions are in bars (see audio.json); the video draws its lamps from the same numbers. analysis/mix_sfx.py mixes both onto the song, each starting on the frame its cue appears.

light.note: Synthesised, modelled on the F1 start-light sound: a short 500 Hz beep over a deep thud near 53 Hz, dry and mono, about half a second long. Pitch, partial levels, glide and envelope were measured from a reference clip of the start-light sound, which is not used or included.
